hero.headline: Become a Member
hero.subline: Join "Motion Mode of Dialogue in Tirol" — your passport to vibrant performances, artistic exchange, and contemporary movement in the Alps.

manifesto.title: We invite culture enthusiasts and artists to become valued members of our association in Tirol.

benefits.label: 01 / Promote Your Art
benefits.title: Amplify Your Voice
benefits.desc: As a member, you gain exclusive access to our extensive social network and mailing list. Share your cultural events, exhibitions, or artistic endeavors with a community that appreciates and supports diverse expressions in Tirol.

benefits.label: 02 / Special Privileges
benefits.title: 20% Discount on Events
benefits.desc: Enjoy a 20% discount on tickets for all our captivating events, including annual dance festivals, workshops, exhibitions, and performances. Connect with the heart of contemporary culture with member privileges.

benefits.label: 03 / Cultural Impact
benefits.title: Support the Creative Sector
benefits.desc: Supporting an independent artistic association creates opportunities within the creative sector, stimulates local cultural initiatives, and fosters international artistic exchange across Tirol.

tiers.title: Cultural Enthusiast
features: Enjoy a 20% discount on all association activities, festivals, and performances.
Immerse yourself in a vibrant international cultural community in Tirol.
Directly support independent contemporary dance and visual art projects.

tiers.title: Professional Artist
features: Access a 20% discount on all association events, workshops, and festivals.
Showcase and promote your art project through our website, social networks, and mailing lists.
Participate in collaborative artistic exchanges and residencies.
